This beauty is from Tiny Homes ATX based out of Texas built in 2024. I purchased it and had it delivered this past December to it's current home in Monrovia, California.
This open space design allows for maximum use of every bit of space which is important in a tiny home.   The original stairs didn't quite work for us so we had a custom staircase built that was more comfortable and functional.  If you want to  enjoy more space while hanging out below in the living room area you can easily lift the steps out of the way and bring them back down when you're ready to use them. Several other changes have been made to the original layout including 2 additional kitchen cabinets and relocating the area for the refrigerator to behind the wall. The electric induction stove top that came with this unit was replaced with a 4 burner propane gas range due to the current electrical source that is provided by the property not being sufficient to handle the stove requirements. Nor that of the instant hot water heater that originally came with this home. I replaced it as well with a new 30 Gallon gas water heater installed beside the home.
The propane stove and gas water heater are much more energy and cost efficient.
Should you decide that you would like to swap out the propane stove for the electric range it is stored in a box in the shed.
Speaking of.. a newly built 8x10 shed is included providing ample storage space.  It is also where a new washer and electric dryer are located. They aren't currently hooked up as we had decided to sell the home before we ever needed to use them.
The lofts can be used as bedrooms or office space both come with added cube storage shelves with storage boxes that are not yet shown in the photos.  Each loft has a skylight for added natural light and cell shades to darken the space when desired.
A retractable screen door was installed allowing for
fresh air to flow in while keeping the bugs out. There is 1 dedicated off street parking beside the home and additional free street parking.
The added porch awning adds a comfortable place to relax outside without the sun beating down on you on hot days and provides great coverage when it's raining.

Perched above the historic Monterey Road Pass in the cozy hillside neighborhood of Hermon, this updated and remodeled home offers scenic views and tranquil living. Tucked between Arroyo Seco, Monterey Hills, Highland Park, and South Pasadena, you’ll find a hidden gem that blends peaceful seclusion with easy city access. Brick-lined stairs lead to a charming composite front deck, perfect for morning coffee or evening sunsets with views stretching across Hermon and the Monterey Hills. Entering through the front door, the living room welcomes you with engineered hardwood flooring and dual-pane windows that fill the space with natural light. The layout flows into a dining area and a thoughtfully updated kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances—including a gas range, dishwasher, microwave, and fridge—and easy-to-clean linoleum flooring. Down the hall, both bedrooms are comfortably sized and feature lighted ceiling fans and generous closets. The first bathroom boasts tile flooring, a dual-sink vanity with river rock countertops, and a custom-tiled shower stall with a rain shower head and matching river rock floors. At the end of the hall is a second full bathroom with sleek black hex tile, a deep soaking tub with oversized subway tile walls, a rain shower head, handheld shower head, and a stylish single-sink vanity. A brand-new stackable washer and dryer is conveniently tucked away here too. Out back, the home extends into a multi-level outdoor oasis. A wood deck off the kitchen makes for a great dining or lounge spot, leading up to a terraced hillside landscaped with lush greenery. The middle terrace offers a patch of artificial grass, market lights, and multiple spots to entertain or relax. Climb a bit higher and you’ll find a quiet seating area at the top—ideal for taking in panoramic views of the hills and skyline. Backed up against Ernest E. Debs Regional Park and with quick access to Rose Hill Park, Hermon Park, Downtown LA, and Dodger Stadium via the Arroyo Seco Parkway, this hillside retreat offers both charm and convenience in one of Northeast LA’s best-kept secrets.

address: N. Ogden Drive, West Hollywood, CA 90046
description:
QR Code Link to This Post
Thank you for checking out my post!
I’m seeking a sublet for a cozy bungalow apartment for one to three months starting May 1st for $2795 per month.
This is an exceptionally low price compared to the fees and current higher rates on Airbnb; considering that it is a furnished 1 bedroom bungalow that includes all utilities, including hi speed wifi that tops 400 mbps, Amazon Prime and Netflix. A laundry room is onsite. Also; the home has been custom designed with with love by an artist/carpenter, unlike the scores of white washed condo cookie cutter units that favor starkness over character. And the best part; no elevators or stairs to walk up. Instead you walk through a lush garden into your peaceful oasis, with very friendly neighbors who respect your privacy but still still say hi and smile when you pass by them.
(This is not for someone relocating to Los Angeles with their belongings. It is ideal for a remote worker or someone who is traveling light and is here simply here for work or is considering moving here.)
If you are still interested then read on. :)
________________________________
Details...
Cozy bungalow apartment filled with artwork and custom wood work created by yours truly.
A 5 minute walk to the heart of West Hollywood and all major streets like Santa Monica Blvd., Sunset Blvd., Melrose Ave., including Whole Foods that is around the corner, and Trader Joes that's three blocks away on Sunset Blvd..
The bedroom features a new queen size memory foam bed and pillows with 100% linen comforter; a small but very cool custom made wood office nook for conducting online office work, and a walk in closet that will be completely emptied out for your stay.
The living room features an adjustable sofa and a custom made solid wood dining room table that can double as an office work station.
There are 55” 4K Smart TVs in both the living room and the bedroom.
The bathroom features a large bath and shower, with two adjustable shower heads (one large rain shower above and one adjustable handheld), a water bidet, and an air conditioner to reduce humidity and cool off the bathroom.
The kitchen features a gas stove with new air vent; pots, pans and the full range of amenities like a Bialetti espresso maker, coffee grinder, air fryer, food processor, Ninja blender, microwave, toaster, food compost bin for scraps, and teas, spices, etc.
The outside area features a cool lil tropical garden planted with care by yours truly, along with a Mexican chiminea fire pit.
A street parking permit will be available, if you'll be using a car during your stay.
There is a nominal cleaning fee of $90 for day of departure.
__________________________________
Who I'm seeking...
I am preferably seeking someone who is exceptionally neat, does not drink a lot, nor smoke, and will not invite guests over. (This is important to remember; as allowing other locals into my personal home is something I’m not comfortable with as it's not a stand alone rental - it's my home). In rare instances; you can message me in advance with the name and relationship to the guest that you’d like to invite during the day, if you're long time friends. But I prefer they do not spend the night.
This is more suited for a single occupancy. However if you’re a couple making the inquiry; then the monthly rate will incur an additional charge per night (which is negotiable depending on the circumstances).
In a nutshell; this apartment is suited for a working professional who desires a dedicated workspace along with calm and peace. The neighbors here all know each other and are very helpful if you ever need anything. It's a quiet complex in which everyone lives along side each other harmoniously.
Initial interviews will be conducted over the phone. If the conversation goes smooth then we can then conduct a Zoom/Face-time meeting to finalize.
And finally; I will only respond to emails that include my name in the introduction, and a brief introduction of yourself; what you do, and what brings you to Los Angeles; and most importantly, a phone number I can reach you at. No one under the age of 25 will be considered.
Those with an Airbnb or Linkedin profile will be prioritized.
Cheers!
Michael

Make this Mid-Century Modern, 3 bedroom 2 bath unit your home.
It's all about location, and just about everywhere you need to go is located a short walk or drive from your new abode.  Hankering for a fancy brew and carbs?  Urff Caffe, Stumptown Coffee Roasters, Bread Lounge, Blue Bottle Coffee, The Pie Hole are all less than 5 minutes away in the Arts District.  Got classes at SciArc?  Walk to school!  Work in Downtown or the LAC/USC Medical Center?  Live here and cut your commute down to mere minutes.  No need to find a designated driver to enjoy the abundant nightlife that Downtown offers as you can simply walk the few blocks to the Metro at Mariachi Plaza! Like to jog or walk your dog?  The verdant grounds and fountains of Hollenbeck Park can be seen from your front door.
Conveniently situated in Boyle Heights on the border of the Arts District, you get the best of both Guisados Tacos and Church&State The Farmer's Market at Mariachi Plaza and Artists&Fleas at Mateo St; Eastside Luv and Villains Tavern.  And don't forget the quick access to the 5, 10, 60, 710, 101 freeways.
The unit itself is spacious at approximately 1700 sq ft.  Front door opens directly into the large and sunny living room which flows seamlessly into the dining room, followed by the kitchen and separate laundry room beyond.  The kitchen features double ovens, quartz countertops, stainless steel sink and 36" fridge, and original plywood cabinets.  The laundry room includes a laundry sink, a pair of stacked Samsung front loading washer/dryer, and access to the private side alleyway.
From the living room, a hallway leads to the bedrooms and 2 baths.  All 3 bedrooms are unusually large, with ample closet space.  The rear bedroom also has its own separate back entrance and private access to the second bathroom.
Mid-Century Modern details include concrete floors in the dining area, kitchen, and bathrooms; sparkly countertops that evoke a googie feel; a sputnik chandelier, and geometric aluminum windows.
Even though the property is located in a residential neighborhood, it is on 4th St right next to the 5 Fwy, and as such, there will be some traffic noise. It is barely noticeable when the windows are closed, but may be a nuisance for those with low tolerance.
Unit is part of a 4 unit complex and includes 1 dedicated parking spot (can possibly fit 2 small cars).  Tenant pays all utilities except water.  Well behaved puppies and kitties welcome.  First month's rent plus security deposit equal to 1 month's rent due at signing.  Available now!

We generally work in "professional-type" careers. We're social, clean, respectful, responsible, laid-back, and easy to get along/live with. Same sort of description above in terms of clean, respectful, responsible, laid-back, easy to get along with, etc. Obviously able to pay rent always on time. Pretty much a normal person! Sorry but no smoking inside the house, no couples, and no pets.
